body:
DECISION: The host-contract version that applies to this workspace's integration is **generation 1** (`HOST_CONTRACT_VERSION === 1`). The assembly handshake in `src/effects/runtime.ts:128` — `assertHostContract(1)` — is correct and consistent with the resolved dependency, so `createPalimpsestEffects` passes the exact-match, fail-closed handshake; asserting `2` would throw `HostContractMismatchError` (CONF-A01).

WHY (applying this repo's own precedence policy, docs/engineering/08-source-precedence-policy.md):

1. Level 1 — published contract of the exact pinned version. `package.json` and `pnpm-workspace.yaml` overrides pin all four `@ordarium/*` packages to the ordarium-v1.3.1 release tarballs. The resolved artifacts are `@ordarium/core@1.3.1`, `@ordarium/host-kit@1.3.1`, `@ordarium/ledger-sqlite@1.3.1` (checked in node_modules). `@ordarium/core/dist/src/host.{js,d.ts}` declares `export const HOST_CONTRACT_VERSION = 1`, and `assertHostContract` throws unless the argument equals it. `@ordarium/host-kit/dist/src/index.js` only re-exports that same value from core (no independent host-kit contract constant). So the governing artifact publishes generation 1.

2. Level 2 — normative spec / code. PLMP-CONF-1 (docs/engineering/13) §1.1 and §2 freeze the literal `1` with no tolerance layer, and `test/host_conformance.test.ts` encodes it (1 passes, 2 throws). SPEC and code agree with the artifact.

3. Level 3 — informational record, cannot override. The only source claiming 2 is `docs/engineering/notes/host-contract-note.md`, which self-identifies as "informational (an early integration note)... not normative." Under the repo precedence policy it is explanatory only and never overrides level 1/2; for this proposition it is void.

RESOLVING THE APPARENT CONFLICT: the visible disagreement is not about the contract generation but about the package semver pin. Historical records (docs/engineering/07 revisions r8/r14/r19, docs/engineering/audits/CURRENT-STATE-ASSESSMENT.md) still describe the 1.2.0 four-line pin, while package.json/pnpm-workspace.yaml and the installed tarballs are at 1.3.1. Package version is orthogonal to host-contract generation (core's own comment says the generation is bumped only when the HostInvocationPort shape, port semantics, host-visible error families, or host-side construction defaults change). Across the 1.2.0 → 1.3.1 pin move the generation stayed 1: every normative source records generation 1, and the resolved 1.3.1 artifact still declares 1. The docs/07 revision log simply has not recorded the 1.3.1 pin bump (documentation drift on the semver pin, not on the contract generation).

No peer contact was needed: after provenance analysis this is a stale-informational-note vs exact-pinned-artifact situation resolvable locally by the repo's own source-precedence rule (version scope + explicit non-normativity), not a genuinely unresolved cross-repo authority gap.

RESIDUAL NOTE (non-blocking): docs/engineering/07 should eventually record the 1.2.0→1.3.1 pin bump so the four-layer pin statement matches package.json/overrides/installed artifacts; this does not change the contract-generation answer.
